extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule covers the VK56VD engine only, as that is the only engine model listed in the schedule pages.
2. Standard oil/filter interval is 7,500 miles/6 months; severe-use oil/filter interval is 5,000 miles/6 months.
3. Tire rotation follows the same 7,500-mile/6-month cadence as standard oil changes.
4. Engine coolant: recommended item (*). First replacement at 105,000 miles/84 months; subsequent interval every 75,000 miles/60 months per footnote on page 516.
5. Intelligent Key battery: first inspect at 22,500 miles/18 months; first replace at 45,000 miles/36 months; subsequent replacements every 22,500 miles/18 months (67,500, 90,000, 112,500).
6. Engine drive belts are a recommended (*) item; first inspect at 60,000 miles/48 months, then every 15,000 miles/12 months; replace only if found damaged.
7. Engine valve clearance has no fixed interval — inspect only if valve noise increases.
8. Fuel filter: periodic maintenance not required (in-tank type filter) — omitted from maintenance items.
9. ATF, transfer fluid, front/rear differential oil capacities are listed as '—' (refill to proper level per procedure); no US quart capacity published.
10. Brake fluid, multi-purpose grease, and A/C refrigerant/oil capacities are also listed as '—' in the capacities table.
11. Items marked with '*' in the schedule are recommended by NISSAN but not required to maintain warranty coverage.
12. Spark plugs appear only once at 105,000 miles in the 120,000-mile schedule; no repeat interval is established.
13. Fuel capacity: 26 gal US measure, 21-5/8 gal Imperial per page 520.
14. The 105,000-mile entry on page 516 lists 'Drive belts' inspect (footnote 1) without the '*' marker, but all other drive belt entries at 60k/75k/90k/120k show 'Engine drive belts*'. The item is treated as recommended (*).
